result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, characterized by a complete absence of sidewalks and marked crossings on a two-lane roadway. Pedestrians are forced to walk in the travel lane or on unpaved grass, with no dedicated infrastructure for safe movement or crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no protected space and must walk in the travel lane or on the grass.

hazards.name: Absence of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated or protected area for pedestrians to cross the two-lane road.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible segment of the road

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks to designate safe crossing points, particularly near the cemetery entrance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install signs to alert drivers to the potential presence of pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks and street lighting, but it lacks marked crosswalks for pedestrians crossing the main thoroughfare. The wide roadway and painted buffers suggest a design that prioritizes vehicle flow over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks across the main roadway, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated space.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The intersection geometry and painted buffers allow for high-speed vehicle turns.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the side street may obstruct the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace painted buffers with physical curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a residential two-lane road with a sidewalk on the left side and traffic calming measures in the form of speed humps. However, the immediate intersection lacks marked crosswalks and curb ramps, and there is no sidewalk provided on the right side of the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated space or priority.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk on the right side of the road, forcing pedestrians to walk on the grass or in the roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side near the intersection corner may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the intersection corners for accessibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian network.

result.summary: The image shows a roadway adjacent to a fenced green space, likely a cemetery, with no visible sidewalk or pedestrian infrastructure. Pedestrians are forced to walk on the grass verge or in the street, creating a high-risk environment due to the lack of separation from vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk
hazards.description: No paved walkway exists, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto uneven grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire length of the road edge.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the grass verge to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers at night.
